name: Campus Event Planner service catalog
note: Derived from the BPMN service and send tasks and from docs/process-notes.json (the system field of each task).

services.name: Holiday service
services.description: Tells whether a date is a public holiday in a country.
services.sla: answers in 2 seconds or less; the answer for a date may be cached for 24 hours

operations.name: isPublicHoliday
operations.summary: Is this date a public holiday?

services.name: Facilities service
services.description: Venues, their capacity and penalties, and their reservations.
services.sla: answers in 300 milliseconds or less; available during office hours at least

operations.name: listVenues
operations.summary: List the venues, optionally with a minimum capacity.

operations.name: getVenueAvailability
operations.summary: Can this venue hold this many people on this date?

operations.name: reserveVenue
operations.summary: Reserve a venue for a date.

services.name: Weather service
services.description: The forecast for a date at a place: rain chance and highest temperature.
services.sla: answers in 2 seconds or less; a forecast exists for the next 16 days only

operations.name: getForecast
operations.summary: The forecast for one date, in a normalized form.

services.name: Finance service
services.description: Deposits: how much of a deposit is still unpaid, and payments.
services.sla: answers in 300 milliseconds or less; available during office hours at least

operations.name: getDeposit
operations.summary: The unpaid balance of the deposit of a request.

operations.name: recordPayment
operations.summary: Record a payment against a deposit.

services.name: Currency conversion service
services.description: Converts an amount in another currency to Philippine pesos.
services.sla: answers in 2 seconds or less; the rate may be one day old

operations.name: convert
operations.summary: Convert an amount to pesos at the latest rate.

services.name: Notification service
services.description: Sends a notice about a decision to the organizer.
services.sla: accepts a notice in 500 milliseconds or less; delivery is tried again later when the mail server is down

operations.name: sendNotice
operations.summary: Send the decision and its reasons to an e-mail address.

services.name: Student Affairs service
services.description: Event requests: create, read, list and change the status of a request.
services.sla: answers in 300 milliseconds or less; available during office hours at least

operations.name: listRequests
operations.summary: List the requests, optionally of one status.

operations.name: getRequest
operations.summary: One request with all its details.

operations.name: submitRequest
operations.summary: Create a new request with the status Pending.

operations.name: updateRequestStatus
operations.summary: Change the status of a request.
